import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from kt import *

FAIL = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True))
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True))
    else:
        print("ok  ", name)

types = [{"name": "Pt", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["x", "N"], ["y", "N"]]},
         {"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 32},
         {"name": "Pts", "kind": "array", "element": "Pt", "size": 2}]
mods = [{"name": "main", "params": [["p", "Pt"], ["ps", "Pts"]],
         "result": ["out", "Pts"], "requires": None}]
# layout: p -> id0 struct, x id1, y id2 ; ps -> id3 array, elem0 id4 struct x id5 y id6,
#          elem1 id7 struct x id8 y id9 ; out -> id10 array, elem0 id11 (x id12,y id13),
#          elem1 id14 (x id15,y id16)
objects = [("x1", u(1, 4)), ("x2", u(2, 4)),
           ("x5", u(3, 4)), ("x6", u(4, 4)),
           ("x8", u(5, 4)), ("x9", u(6, 4)),
           ("x12", u(7, 4)), ("x13", u(8, 4)),
           ("x15", u(9, 4)), ("x16", u(10, 4))]
runs = [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(objects)}]
camp = {"types": types, "modules": mods, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["main"],
        "machine": None, "runs": runs}
out = run(camp)
check("aggregate slots", out['plans'][0]['slots'],
      [["x1", ["p", "x"], 4], ["x2", ["p", "y"], 4],
       ["x5", ["ps", 0, "x"], 4], ["x6", ["ps", 0, "y"], 4],
       ["x8", ["ps", 1, "x"], 4], ["x9", ["ps", 1, "y"], 4],
       ["x12", ["out", 0, "x"], 4], ["x13", ["out", 0, "y"], 4],
       ["x15", ["out", 1, "x"], 4], ["x16", ["out", 1, "y"], 4]])
check("aggregate variables", out['plans'][0]['variables'], 17)
check("aggregate types", out['plans'][0]['types'], ["Pt"])
check("aggregate inputs", out['corpus'][0]['inputs'],
      {"p": {"x": 1, "y": 2}, "ps": [{"x": 3, "y": 4}, {"x": 5, "y": 6}]})
check("aggregate result", out['records'][0]['model_result'],
      [{"x": 7, "y": 8}, {"x": 9, "y": 10}])

# the same struct reached through two entries keeps its identity
mods2 = mods + [{"name": "other", "params": [["p", "Pt"]], "result": ["o", "N"],
                 "requires": None}]
runs2 = [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(objects)},
         {"entry": "other", "ktest": ktest([("x1", u(1, 4)), ("x2", u(2, 4)), ("x3", u(9, 4))])}]
camp = {"types": types, "modules": mods2, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
        "entries": ["main", "other"], "machine": None, "runs": runs2}
out = run(camp)
check("entries do not merge", len(out['corpus']), 2)
check("entries corpus entries", [c['entry'] for c in out['corpus']], ["main", "other"])

print()
print("FAILURES:", FAIL if FAIL else "none")
PYEOF
